title: Toolkit Launchpad: Starter Flow and Contextual Recommendations for Batching, Caching & Quant UI
text:
Toolkit Launchpad: Starter Flow and Contextual Recommendations for Batching, Caching & Quant UI

description:
Design the 'Launchpad' starter experience that surfaces contextual Optimize recommendations for new users and first-run post-upgrade. This ticket covers visual assets, a minimal screenshot inventory for the Console, docs imagery for the quickstart docs, copy variants for the recommendation cards, and a small illustration set for progressive disclosure. Key deliverables should work for hosted and dedicated customers and be easily swapped for Private deployments with custom branding.

goal:
Reduce time-to-first-optimization action by making batching/caching/quant recommendations obvious during first-use. Provide clear, scannable UI screenshots and doc visuals that engineering can implement without extra microcopy iteration.

background:
Product wants a lightweight first-run surface that complements the existing Optimize toolkit modal but focuses on three action areas: batching suggestions, prefix/KV cache hints, and quantization profile prep. Engineering provided component constraints (compact cards, 320–1040px screenshots, single CTA per card). UX research indicated users prefer a single prioritized suggestion rather than multiple simultaneous prompts on first run.

decisions:
Use a 3-card horizontal carousel on the Launchpad: Batching / Cache / Quantization
Prioritize a single primary CTA per card: Apply Suggestion / Preview Simulation / Learn More
Keep cards neutral color palette to match Console theme; use accent color for CTA only
Illustrations will be small 48x48 glyphs — not full-screen hero art — to keep screenshots legible
Defer multi-step quant flows (profile tuning) to a deeper modal; Launchpad only offers profile suggestions and a preview

deliverables:
Console screenshots: Launchpad hero (desktop), compact card state (collapsed/expanded), confirmation toast
Docs visuals: single-page quickstart hero (800x420), step-by-step images for 'Apply Suggestion' flow
Figma file with annotated components, export-ready slices (PNG/SVG) and copy variants
Localization-ready microcopy table (EN + placeholders for DE/FR/JP)
Hand-off spec doc with CSS spacing tokens and accessible contrast notes

tasks:
Design exploratory sketches and high-fidelity comps (Ava)
Sync with runtime eng on CTA behavior and telemetry (Liam)
Create screenshot export set and naming convention (DES27834-snap-*)
Prepare docs image pack and upload to Drive
Run brief usability check with 3 product engineers and 2 PMs
Finalize copy and submit handoff to frontend with PR references

acceptance_criteria:
Three unique high-fidelity card screenshots (collapsed/expanded/confirmed) exported at 320px, 720px, and 1040px widths
Figma file contains named components and tokens; dev spec includes CSS variables and accessibility notes
Docs visuals uploaded to Drive with suggested alt text and localization keys
PM and Runtime Eng have approved the primary CTA behavior and fallback (A/B or single CTA) in comments
One front-end PR references this ticket and consumes the exported assets

designer_notes:
Favor condensed copy for first-run: 1-line title + 1-sentence body. For batching card, show estimated median latency delta and cost savings ribbon (fictional sample data for screenshots only). For quant card, show suggested profile name and an optional 'simulate' preview that shows token/per-second tradeoffs. Provide two copy tones: 'friendly' and 'straightforward' for PM to choose.

engineering_notes:
Frontend constraints: cards must be accessible with keyboard nav and screen reader labels; use aria-live region for confirmation toast. Telemetry: fire event optimize.launchpad.shown and optimize.launchpad.applied with suggestion_id. Backend will return suggestion payload at /api/v1/optimize/suggestions. Work with runtime team to ensure suggestions include simulation params.

qa_steps:
Load Launchpad in a staging org with a fresh workspace and verify only one prioritized card is highlighted by default
Keyboard: Tab through cards and activate primary CTA with Enter/Space
Screen reader: Confirm card title and CTA are announced and confirmation toast is accessible
Screenshot tests: Compare exported images to approved Figma slices at 3 widths
Telemetry: Confirm events appear in staging analytics pipeline on show/apply

comments:
2025-01-09 - Liam Chen: Quick sync with runtime team — backend can return up to 3 suggestions; we'll surface only the top-ranked by confidence to reduce cognitive load.
2025-01-10 - Maya Patel (PM): Prefer straightforward copy for enterprise customers. Also request an extra screenshot with 'Dedicated' context showing reserved capacity hint.
2025-01-13 - Ava Martinez: Uploaded first hi-fi comps to Figma (links above). Two variants: one with small inline estimates and one with a separate 'savings' ribbon.
2025-01-15 - Liam Chen: Frontend component accepted the markup; added aria attributes. Waiting on final copy and illustration assets.
2025-01-20 - QA: Minor contrast issue on ribbon callout; designer to adjust color tokens for AA compliance.
